raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 0.11.1

package:
  name: colt5-attention
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/lucidrains/colt5-attention/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 597f1e4af5b9006d8969d73905ea03fcc55945cfb0ab7d3d722fd05fff6322f6

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python =${{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - einops >=0.8.0
    - local-attention >=1.8.6
    - packaging
    - pytorch >=1.10

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - colt5_attention
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python =${{ python_min }}
    script:
      - pip check

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Implementation of the conditionally routed attention in the CoLT5 architecture, in Pytorch
  homepage: https://github.com/lucidrains/CoLT5-attention

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - danielnachun
